findings: Initial image has a legible tapered trunk, endpoint forks, generation colour and visible coral terminal dots.
Appending a generation adds finer terminal twigs while native checks preserve earlier geometry/attributes/ancestry.
Narrowing aligns upper twigs; wider turns visibly open the side branches; binary slots produce a narrow stalk-like spray.
Alternate palette changes dark/green/coral to purple/orange; thin mode removes taper/tip dots while retaining geometry.
Seven placed roots produce distinct small branching forms, with meaningful taper/palette/generation edits; changed seed changes the forest and may produce early-terminated stems.
visual_review.scope: Technique-level endpoint branching and retained style/placement composition, not source-pixel reproduction.

limitations: Core/adapter assertions and images do not establish other targets or full corpus certification.
Root exclusion does not prevent canopy overlap; thin marks and early terminal branches are intentional explicit policies.
